definition.fake_move: Price movement designed to trigger stops, hunt liquidity, or deceive retail traders before reversing. Often created by spoofing, iceberg manipulation, or stop runs.
definition.real_move: Institutional price movement with genuine intent to establish position. Characterized by sustained volume, absorption of supply/demand, and market structure confirmation.

fake_move_signals: Expansion phase in ICT methodology (overextension before retracement)
Stop runs at key liquidity levels
Fake absorption (small lots appearing as large)
real_move_signals: Retracement complete in ICT methodology (institutional entry)
